verdict.rationale: Published pricing is a fair question for a knowledge/memory product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions pricing, a free tier, or per-unit rates. The only cost-adjacent fact is that Knowledge is stored in the user's own configured storage provider, which is a host-side arrangement, not published pricing.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published pricing with a free tier and per-unit rates so I can project memory costs before committing
